map.由各组分的物质的量求摩尔分数 使用指南: Mole fraction from component amounts guide
map.摩尔分数计算器，输入两种或多种组分物质的量自动归一化为摩尔分数，用于混合物组成表: Mole fraction calculator: enter the amount of substance for two or more components and it normalizes to mole fractions for expressing mixture composition.
map.x_i = n_i / Σn_i，所有 x_i 之和为 1。 仅统计正数输入项。: x_i = n_i / sum of n_i, and all x_i sum to 1. Only positive input entries are counted.
map.输入两种或多种组分的物质的量，自动归一化为摩尔分数。: Enter the amount of substance for two or more components and it normalizes to mole fractions automatically.
map.填写「组分3 物质的量（可0） (mol)」。: Fill in "component 3 amount of substance (0 allowed) (mol)".
map.二元溶液：由两组分摩尔算 x_A、x_B（和为 1）。: Binary solution: compute x_A and x_B from the moles of the two components (they sum to 1).
map.道尔顿分压：x_i 乘总压得组分分压。: Dalton's law: multiply total pressure by x_i to get a component's partial pressure.
map.理想溶液活度近似：稀溶液用 x 近似活度。: Ideal-solution activity approximation: use x as an approximation of activity for dilute solutions.
: entering A 2 mol, B 3 mol makes the tool output x_A = 0.40, x_B = 0.60 and notes that all components sum to 1.
map.道尔顿分压（Pᵢ = xᵢ · P_总）: Dalton's law of partial pressure (P_i = x_i x P_total)
map.由酸解离常数与浓度估算 pH: Estimate pH from the acid dissociation constant and concentration
map.所有组分和为 1；不为 1 说明漏组分或算错。: All components sum to 1; if not, a component is missing or miscalculated.
map.和体积分数一样吗？: Is it the same as volume fraction?
map.理想气体近似等，液体不等（分子体积差）。: For ideal gases they are roughly equal, but not for liquids (molecular volumes differ).
map.多组分怎么算？: How to handle more than two components?
map.分别 n_i/Σn，本质同二元推广。: Take n_i/sum n separately; essentially the same generalization as the binary case.
